adapted_from.source_text: Translate the supplied outfit into a full-length fashion illustration. Preserve its cut, belt placement, neckline and trouser width. Draw the adult figure with economical charcoal-black contour lines and warm beige watercolor washes. Let a few unfinished strokes trail beyond the hem, while the face and garment construction stay legible. Leave generous white paper around the figure. Show both feet and a light ground mark. Do not turn fabric folds into extra limbs or add captions.
